_comment: Redacted shape of ~/.dontpanic/adapters/linear.json — the per-service config the PP-emitted Linear MCP binary reads at spawn. Operator copies to the real path (gitignored), replaces <paste-your-token> with a Linear read-scope personal API key, and never commits the populated copy. Token values exist only at the operator's home dir.
notes: v1 pin reflects the paid Linear run on 2026-05-20. Bumping pp_version requires a v2 expansion plan per SKILL.md Reference. F003 used Linear's official GraphQL SDL; v2 should update the decision tree so GraphQL-backed external APIs are first-class rather than described as OpenAPI-only.
